text: The chairs and vice chairs of the community councils are elected by the Members of the community councils for each half of the Council term under s. 270132 of the Council Procedures. An election is required for Vice Chair to replace Councillor Lee for the term June 6, 2018 to November 30, 2018. All Members are eligible for election with one exception: a community council chair cannot also serve as the Speaker of City Council.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Elected Councillor Jim Karygiannis as Vice Chair of the Scarborough Community Council for the term June 6, 2018 to November 30, 2018.
